subject: Timing conflict: demo on Nov 2 — DST and Diwali overlap, options
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Satish Rao <satish@orbithealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya@mediq.in>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timing conflict: demo on Nov 2 — DST and Diwali overlap, options

Hi Satish / Priya —

Thanks for agreeing to the product demo. I booked a provisional slot on Tuesday, Nov 2 at 10:00 PT / 18:00 GMT. Before I finalize the calendar invite I wanted to flag two potential conflicts that came up on our side & yours:

1) US daylight savings ends on Nov 1 (first Sunday in Nov). That will shift the West Coast offset and could confuse cross-region attendees if we leave the invite without clarifying time zones.
2) Priya mentioned Diwali week in India — I confirmed with her that Nov 2 is likely within travel/OOO for parts of the MedIQ team.

Options I propose (please pick one):
- A: Keep Nov 2 but move to earlier (07:30 PT / 10:00 ET) to make it earlier for APAC attendees
- B: Move to Nov 4 or Nov 5 (avoid immediate post-DST churn and Diwali)
- C: Keep Nov 2 and run a shorter walk-through tailored to EMEA & US only, and run a separate APAC session the next week

I attached the demo agenda and the SOW for reference. Marcus / Stephanie — any constraints from your side for Nov 2–6?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: OrbitHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf), demo-reqs.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Satish Rao <satish@orbithealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@mediq.in>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 22:03:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Timing conflict: demo on Nov 2 — DST and Diwali overlap, options

Thanks Jasmine —

Good catch on Diwali. Our core evaluation team in Hyderabad will be on leave Nov 1–3 for family travel; Nov 4 looks safer for them. Satish (me) can do Nov 2, but I want the main product owners present.

If Nov 4 works on your side, that's my preference. If not, separate APAC-focused session sounds fine.

Also, please note that one of our EU stakeholders (Hana) is traveling to Japan Oct 31–Nov 5 for an integration review and has limited daytime availability JST.

Best,
Satish Rao
VP of Product | OrbitHealth

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timing conflict: demo on Nov 2 — DST and Diwali overlap, options

Jasmine / team —

Nov 4 looks fine from our side. Two operational checks:
- We should avoid scheduling the demo across the DST transition window to prevent calendar clients from reinterpreting the time (iCal clients are notorious for that). Since DST ends Nov 1, scheduling Nov 4 removes that ambiguity.
- If we split sessions, Stephanie can run an APAC session on Nov 9 (morning JST) to accommodate Hana and the Hyderabad team.

I can send proposed ics invites for Nov 4 (global) and Nov 9 (APAC) if we agree.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
